record_notes.DCP-LETT-1271: Sunday assigned November 18, 1849. Rereads de Beaumont and rejects rectangular dike-to-lava junctions categorically without detailed hammer examination. Own Galapagos and St Jago observations support contemporary argument, while Etna, Santorin and Vesuvius are comparisons. Friday committee recommendation of J. D. Forbes for Royal Medal is current; later council reversal and Mantell award are future. Condolences and illness are separate news. Dan Sharpe agreement is oral, not proof the later 1851 paper was read. Missing Lyell discussion or communication is not another outgoing Darwin letter. Claim is subsequently revised in 1275 after Dana reading.
